preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The input root must be either None or a TreeNode object representing the root of a binary tree.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, TreeNode) for node in [root.left, root.right]) if root else True
preconditions.description: If root is not None, its left and right children must also be TreeNode objects or None.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for node in subtree_nodes if is_single_valued_subtree(node))
postconditions.description: The function returns the count of all single-valued subtrees in the tree rooted at root, where a single-valued subtree is defined as a subtree where all nodes have the same value.

postconditions.expression: all(is_single_valued_subtree(node) == (all(node.val == child.val for child in [node.left, node.right] if child is not None) if node else True) for node in subtree_nodes)
postconditions.description: A subtree rooted at node is single-valued if and only if all its children (if any) have the same value as node, and recursively, all subtrees rooted at its children are single-valued.
